title: A Novel Biplex Onchocerca volvulus Rapid Diagnostic Test: Feasibility and Comparison with the Ov16 SD Bioline Rapid Diagnostic Test Among 3–9-Year-Old Children in Maridi, South Sudan
content: The DDTD biplex A RDT prototype was easy to use in the field but the evaluation of its performance relative to the commercially available Ov16 SD Bioline RDT will require additional research. The high Ov16 seroprevalence suggests high ongoing O. volvulus transmission around the Maridi Dam. Therefore, strengthening the onchocerciasis elimination program in Maridi should be a public health priority.
